title: Admin Internal Account-Status Endpoints

criteria_checked.AC2_accountstatus_suspendedat_new_indepe: PASS - Tech Lead ran `dotnet ef migrations add AddAccountStatusToUsers` + `dotnet ef database update` against the live sqlserver container (host port 14330); verified via INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS that users.AccountStatus (nvarchar, default 'Active') and users.SuspendedAt (datetime2, nullable) now exist on the real UserServiceDb, independent of the existing Status column

last_note: All 4 acceptance criteria PASS. Migration applied and verified against the live DB. Also wired (beyond the ticket's explicit file list, but required for the integration to actually work end to end): admin-service's userServiceWebClient now attaches the same X-Internal-Service-Key shared-secret header the new endpoints enforce (UserServiceProperties.internalServiceKey, WebClientConfig default header, application.yml user-service.internal-service-key, docker-compose.override.yml INTERNAL_SERVICE_KEY env var on admin-service) - without this the three new endpoints would 401 every admin-service call, since that guard already existed on the fcm-token internal endpoint and the new ones match it.
